% headings — the heading sequence, and nothing else.
%
% One concern: does a run of headings at three depths come back as headings at
% three depths, in the right order, with their text intact? No lists, no styling,
% no figures, and short bodies that exist only to prove a heading ended. When this
% fixture fails, heading detection or ordering is what broke, and nothing else can
% be blamed for it.
%
% Untagged on purpose. Most PDFs are, and the layout path — which infers a heading
% from its size and weight relative to body text — is the one that reads them. The
% tagged counterpart is clauses.tex.
%
% lmodern and no [T1]{fontenc}: see README.md. Without lmodern pdfTeX can embed PK
% bitmaps as Type 3 fonts whose glyph names carry no character meaning, and T1
% writes /Differences entries naming font-encoding slots that look like Unicode and
% are not.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}

\section{First Section}

Body of the first section.

\subsection{A Subsection}

Body of the subsection.

\subsubsection{A Sub-subsection}

Body of the sub-subsection.

\section{Second Section}

Body of the second section.

\end{document}
